rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for distributing something over individual items, as in 每隻碗 for “each bowl.”

example.jyutping: mui5 zek3 wun2 dou1 sai2 gon1 zeng6 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for each person or thing when the noun is understood or follows it.

example.english: Each person has their own opinion.
example.traditional: 每個人都有自己嘅諗法。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3

rows.note: Use this specifically for each person, especially in phrases such as each of you.

example.jyutping: mui5 jan4 paai3 loeng5 zoeng1 fei1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on dealing with people or things one by one.

example.english: We called each person by name to enter.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zuk6 go3 giu3 meng2 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this when each person acts separately or does their own part rather than collectively.

example.english: After dinner, we each went home.
example.traditional: 食完飯我哋各自返屋企。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 ngo5 dei6 gok3 zi6 faan1 uk1 kei2
